thread:
Giselle (CS): Heads up  multiple onboarding customers are seeing incorrect dashboard metrics after recent indexing. Customers noticed dropped events and skewed counts starting ~08:10 UTC. We need a concise customer status, remediation plan, and renewal-risk wording.

Arjun - CS Ops: Can we bucket by impact: two buckets — 'metrics-blocking' (dashboard unusable for go-live) and 'metrics-degraded' (counts off but usable). I'll export lists.

Giselle (CS): Uploaded buckets to #cs-ops-docs. Metrics-blocking: acct-vela, acct-eden. Metrics-degraded: ~11 trials and 3 paid.

Fiona (Support): Suggested offer: blocking accounts get immediate priority re-ingest + 2-week onboarding extension + 12% service credit. Degraded get 1-week extension + 6% credit. Offer live data validation session.

Samir (SRE): Quick root-cause: event-normalizer dropped batched telemetry when a size-check change hit the stream processor during deploy. Rolled back faulty change at 08:28 UTC and resumed processing. Backfill jobs started; ETA depends on backlog size.

Noelle (Product): For renewal-risk accounts propose assigning a senior success lead and a direct AM sync. Also consider granting temporary elevated ingestion throughput for 48h for critical customers (ops + billing signoff needed).

Giselle (CS): Draft status blurb: "We apologize  an internal processing issue caused some recent events to be omitted from analytics dashboards. Engineering has deployed a fix and we are reprocessing missing events. We'll prioritize accounts most affected and follow up with an ETA for when dashboard metrics will be accurate."

Arjun - CS Ops: For renewal-risk add: "If this impacts your contractual go-live, we will escalate and provide tailored remediation and compensation options; a senior success lead will be assigned." Strong reassurance.

Samir (SRE): Customer-facing FAQ blurb: "Cause: a size-check regression in the event-normalizer caused batched telemetry to be dropped during a deploy. Fix: rolled back the change, resumed ingestion, and started backfills. Mitigations: backfill monitoring, deploy-time data validation, and alerting on ingestion loss."

Fiona (Support): Action: I need CSV with columns (account, impact, owner, contact-email, MRR) to run segmented sends and the pulse. Can we get that by 11:00am PT?

Giselle (CS): CSV uploaded. @Noelle confirm credit policy and who to cc for approvals. @Samir post next backfill progress.

Noelle (Product): Billing pre-approves up to 15% credit for <$4k MRR; AM approval above. Temporary throughput increase requires ops tag and billing notification.

Samir (SRE): Progress 09:05 UTC  28% of missing events reprocessed; verification checks passing on processed batches. New ETA ~3-5 hours for current queue. Will post updates every 30m.

Arjun - CS Ops: I'll draft two templates (blocking + degraded) and post in #cs-review in 10m. Please review quickly.

StatusBot: Templates uploaded to #cs-review (link)  requesting signoff from @Giselle, @Noelle, @Samir.

Giselle (CS): We'll include a 2-question pulse: 1) Did this block your go-live? 2) Would you like a live data validation session? Responses will feed the renewal-risk tracker.

Fiona (Support): I'll wire the automation to capture responses into CS tracker and tag any urgent replies for escalation.

Samir (SRE): Full postmortem ETA: end of day tomorrow. We'll include timeline, root cause, and actions (data-validation gate + deploy checks + owner assignments).

Giselle (CS): Reminder: cc billing@redwood.com on credits and loop AMs for at-risk renewals. Will send after signoff and post the recipient list here.

Arjun - CS Ops: Noted. Scheduling follow-ups and priority slots for validation sessions.

Fiona (Support): Ready to monitor replies and escalate urgent issues.

Samir (SRE): Updating channel with progress in 30m.

Giselle (CS): Thanks team  executing plan now.
